d: To ensure accurate financial reporting, effective general ledger management, cost control, and timely financial closings while supporting budgeting, audits, and process improvements. The role contributes to informed business decision-making through financial analysis, compliance, and collaboration with cross-functional teams.
q: Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance or related field.
Professional certifications (ACCA, CPA, CA, etc.) are an added advantage.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in accounting or a related field.
Strong background in general ledger management, month-end closing, and financial reporting
Experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliation, and cost control
Proven ability to build effective working relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.
Creative, resourceful, and pragmatic, with a positive, solution-focused attitude.
Experience working on Oracle Fusion is an added advantage.
r: Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
Ensure timely and accurate financial reporting.
Proficient use of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Prepare and maintain the general ledger.
Strong knowledge of recipe creation and product costing.
Prepare and finalize COGS, including variance analysis reports.
Oversee month-end and year-end closing processes.
Ensure timely and accurate completion of all financial closing tasks.
Assist in tracking and monitoring budget vs. actual performance.
Assist in preparing the annual budget.
Support internal and external audits by preparing required documentation.
Identify opportunities to enhance process efficiency.
Implement best practices to enhance financial processes.
Work Closely with other departments to gather financial information.
Provide guidance and support other team members.
